# IW-Builder: Infinite Worlds Authoring Kit 1.6.0

> Reference kit for AI models that build, edit, review and debug Infinite Worlds (IW) games. Start with the authoring prompt at https://iw-builder.github.io/ (or Authoring-Prompt.md), then fetch only the files the task needs. Every published file is listed below with its direct URL, size and purpose.

Independent and unaffiliated with Infinite Worlds. Sizes are approximate. Integrity hashes for these files are in https://iw-builder.github.io/manifest.json (for verification only; not needed to author).

## Start here

- [index.html](https://iw-builder.github.io/) (23 KB): Homepage: the authoring prompt (same text as Authoring-Prompt.md). Start here.
- [Authoring-Prompt.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/Authoring-Prompt.md) (21 KB): The authoring prompt: task modes, which reference to read for each feature, construction, timing, validation and delivery rules.
- [World-Template.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/World-Template.json) (2 KB): Empty importable world; the starting point for new builds.
- [README.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/guide/) (10 KB): Human guide: workflows, starter requests, import/export steps. Rendered at /guide/; models can skip it.
- [LICENSE](https://iw-builder.github.io/LICENSE) (1 KB): MIT license.

## Reference guides

Read only what the task needs; Authoring-Prompt.md says which guide covers which feature.

- [reference/Capabilities.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Capabilities.md) (23 KB): Turn lifecycle, Skills, NPC cards and keyword blocks, specialist requests, template timing, endings, images, video and model-specific blocks.
- [reference/Craft.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Craft.md) (15 KB): Narrative design: what goes in each field, openings, character cards, romance and adult worlds, prose style, names, example worlds by genre.
- [reference/Current-AI-Profiles.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Current-AI-Profiles.json) (8 KB): Storyteller models, current and retired: block IDs, underlying real-world model, isCurrent flag and typical credits per turn.
- [reference/Default-Evaluation.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Default-Evaluation.txt) (3 KB): IW's built-in Evaluation instructions, verbatim; the baseline for a custom Evaluation.
- [reference/Editor-UI.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Editor-UI.md) (19 KB): Editor labels and their JSON fields, import/export steps, debug tools, visibility, permissions and troubleshooting by symptom.
- [reference/Engineering-Tools.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Engineering-Tools.md) (2 KB): Literal-Scenario plot compiler: commands and limits.
- [reference/Evidence.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Evidence.md) (2 KB): Platform baseline, version numbers and the evidence labels used across the kit.
- [reference/Import-Integrity.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Import-Integrity.md) (4 KB): ID conventions, checks before and after import, editing live copies, and the import audit tool.
- [reference/Known-Limits.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Known-Limits.md) (5 KB): Platform behavior that remains unverified, by area.
- [reference/PawScript.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/PawScript.md) (18 KB): PawScript language guide: syntax, collections, randomness, formatting, debugging, system roots and common mistakes.
- [reference/Portable-Banks.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Portable-Banks.md) (8 KB): Data mode: portable character/data bank format, dependencies, full-content build reports and data_bank.py commands.
- [reference/README.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/README.md) (2 KB): Human-friendly index of the reference guides.
- [reference/Recipes.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Recipes.md) (15 KB): Ways to combine features: situation triggers, thresholds, choices, optional blocks, dynamic content, request/commit, guarded state and turn-state patterns.
- [reference/Schema.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Schema.md) (17 KB): Export structure: field groups, trackers, starting values, condition and effect payloads, comparators and value-effect operations.
- [reference/Story-Tools.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Story-Tools.md) (4 KB): Import comparison and story-text extraction/merge tools: commands and limits.
- [reference/Trackers.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Trackers.md) (7 KB): Tracker fields, data types, visibility, update ownership, starting values and memory/context cost.
- [reference/Trigger-Catalog.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Trigger-Catalog.md) (7 KB): Every identified trigger condition and effect type in one table. Check it before saying a trigger can't do something.
- [reference/Triggers.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Triggers.md) (10 KB): Trigger timing flags, ordering, effect semantics, choosing native effects or PawScript, and start-of-game restrictions.
- [reference/Notable-Findings.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Notable-Findings.md) (11 KB): Plain-language list of the behavior most likely to surprise an author or break a world, with what to do.
- [reference/Verified-Behavior.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/reference/Verified-Behavior.md) (21 KB): Consolidated runtime findings: triggers, imports, PawScript, visibility, memory, forms, images and endings.

## Examples

Each JSON file is a complete importable world demonstrating one feature or combination.

- [examples/README.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/examples/README.md) (6 KB): Human guide to the examples, grouped by what you want to do.
- [examples/Payloads.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/examples/Payloads.md) (17 KB): Compact native payload snippets for every condition and effect, taken from the example worlds.
- [examples/index.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/examples/index.json) (21 KB): Machine index of every example world: purpose, evidence label and verification scope.

## Sample library

Optional modules to adapt into worlds.

- [library/Integration.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/library/Integration.md) (12 KB): How to choose and adapt library modules: Storymaster versus lightweight direction, token costs, dependency checklists. Read before using the library JSON.
- [library/README.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/library/README.md) (1 KB): Human-friendly overview of the library.
- [library/Sample-Blocks.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/library/Sample-Blocks.json) (58 KB): Library modules in world-file format: time/location, characterization, craft, pacing, trackers, image styles and more. Copy whole content values by name.
- [library/Storymaster-Suite.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/library/Storymaster-Suite.json) (34 KB): The Storymaster narrative-direction framework in world-file format. Substantial; read Integration.md first.

## Tools

Python tools for models or users that can run code. Without Python, use the checker.

- [tools/README.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/README.md) (2 KB): Human overview of the tools.
- [tools/Usage.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/Usage.md) (8 KB): Commands, checks, warning meanings and limits for the validator and other tools.
- [tools/validate_iw_export.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/validate_iw_export.py) (19 KB): World validator: schema, references and lint; --diff compares with an original. The main tool to run.
- [tools/iw-export.schema.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/iw-export.schema.json) (48 KB): JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) profile of the IW export format, used by the validator.
- [tools/static_checks.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/static_checks.py) (13 KB): Lint and reference checks used by the validator.
- [tools/data_bank.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/data_bank.py) (11 KB): Create, check, pack/unpack and restore portable data banks and full-content build reports. Standard library only.
- [tools/import_audit.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/import_audit.py) (3 KB): Read-only comparison of a source world with its re-exported import: ID changes and dangling references.
- [tools/story_export.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/story_export.py) (13 KB): Plan, build and verify reviewed extractions of IW story exports; merges only non-conflicting histories.
- [tools/plot_compile.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/plot_compile.py) (6 KB): Builds a fresh world from a literal-Scenario prerequisite plan.
- [tools/example-plot-plan.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/example-plot-plan.json) (1 KB): Sample input for plot_compile.py.
- [tools/Validation-Report.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/Validation-Report.json) (8 KB): Latest package check results (maintainer output).
- [tools/build_distribution.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/build_distribution.py) (28 KB): Maintainer: rebuilds the homepage, combined text files, folder pages, llms.txt, checker and manifest.
- [tools/check_package.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/check_package.py) (3 KB): Maintainer: validates every example world and local link; writes Validation-Report.json.
- [tools/test_validator.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/test_validator.py) (7 KB): Maintainer tests for the validator.
- [tools/test_data_bank.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/test_data_bank.py) (5 KB): Maintainer tests for data_bank.py.
- [tools/test_distribution.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/test_distribution.py) (8 KB): Maintainer tests for the distribution build.
- [tools/test_engineering.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/test_engineering.py) (4 KB): Maintainer tests for the browser harness and plot compiler.
- [tools/test_native_compat.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/test_native_compat.py) (6 KB): Maintainer tests for native export compatibility.
- [tools/test_story_export.py](https://iw-builder.github.io/tools/test_story_export.py) (6 KB): Maintainer tests for story_export.py.

## Browser checker

- [checker/index.html](https://iw-builder.github.io/checker/) (116 KB): Browser validator: paste a world or a model's whole reply; runs validate_iw_export.py locally, joins numbered chunks and copies a report for the AI.

## Combined text editions

Single-file bundles for chats without web access or with tool limits. Web-browsing models should prefer the individual files above.

- [chat/index.html](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/) (92 KB): HTML page containing IW-Authoring-Guide.txt, with links to the companion editions.
- [chat/IW-Authoring-Guide.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Authoring-Guide.txt) (88 KB): Combined text, start here: prompt, template, Evidence, Craft, Trackers, Triggers, Trigger-Catalog, Portable-Banks and library Integration.
- [chat/IW-Technical-Reference.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Technical-Reference.txt) (87 KB): Combined text: Schema, PawScript, Capabilities, Recipes, Default Evaluation and AI profile IDs.
- [chat/IW-Behavior.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Behavior.txt) (62 KB): Combined text: Notable-Findings, Editor-UI, Verified-Behavior, Known-Limits and Import-Integrity.
- [chat/IW-Payloads.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Payloads.txt) (40 KB): Combined text: payload cookbook (every condition and effect) and the example index. Small and essential for mechanics.
- [chat/IW-Mechanics-Examples.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Mechanics-Examples.txt) (101 KB): Combined text: complete mechanics example worlds (recipes, optional block, starting values, showcase).
- [chat/IW-Narrative-Examples.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Narrative-Examples.txt) (102 KB): Combined text: complete narrative example worlds (ensemble romance, fantasy expedition, contained horror).
- [chat/IW-Sample-Blocks.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Sample-Blocks.txt) (61 KB): Combined text: library modules (Sample-Blocks.json). Integration guide is in IW-Authoring-Guide.txt.
- [chat/IW-Storymaster.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Storymaster.txt) (37 KB): Combined text: the Storymaster framework (Storymaster-Suite.json). Integration guide is in IW-Authoring-Guide.txt.
- [chat/IW-Tools.txt](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/IW-Tools.txt) (131 KB): Combined text: tool usage guide, Story-Tools and plot-compiler guides, plus validator, schema and helper sources to recreate locally.
- [chat/README.md](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/README.md) (2 KB): Human guide to the combined text files.
- [chat/sources.json](https://iw-builder.github.io/chat/sources.json) (3 KB): Which source files make up each combined text file, with hashes.
